q: The sofic entropy of a Bernoulli action G ↷ (K^G, μ^G) (with K a finite set, μ uniform) equals:
exp: For Bernoulli actions of sofic groups, Bowen computed the sofic entropy as log|K| (for the uniform measure on K)—matching the classical formula for amenable groups. This was the first major result establishing that sofic entropy extends KS entropy beyond the amenable setting.
